scope: Static deployed artifact integrity only. Ordinary HTTPS GETs at the exact public URLs, preserving declared asset version queries; no added query cache-busting, browser automation, app execution, giant worker/WASM download or native/human verification. Managed files compare with existing reviewed local dist; plain files compare with tracked app/. Source-link inspection is static, not a rendered-link claim. Publication/workflow and real browser checks remain in publication.json. Exact source/build-story hrefs or quoted JS literals were checked in hash-matched files, and their normal GitHub URLs received ordinary HEAD requests.

inspection_notes: Initial link-literal scanner recognized single/double quotes but missed Vite’s backtick literals in executive/process. Direct inspection found the exact href values in the already hash-matched JS; adding backtick recognition resolved both scanner misses. This was an inspection-parser limitation, not a deployed artifact failure. No remote request was repeated for that correction.

Dynamic worker chunks/WASM, fonts and every runtime asset were not downloaded. The record covers HTML, all HTML-linked JS/CSS, key notices, and original-app model imports/linked lessons/template. Root owns rendered behavior verification.
